description: HealthData.gov (HHS) dataset catalogue: dataset ID, name, short description, display type, last rows update and dataset link, for a search term. Catalogue metadata only; some datasets are non-tabular and have no row API. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_data_gov_uk when you need UK government open datasets from the data.gov.uk catalogue; gov_clinicaltrials when you need ClinicalTrials.gov studies matching a condition, drug. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
